_comment: Claude Desktop. Prefer Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector and paste https://app.sentineliq.net/api/v1/mcp/public — no config file needed. This file is the fallback for a build that only speaks stdio: it bridges the HTTP transport with the third-party npm package `mcp-remote`, which is not maintained by SENTINEL. macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json — Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Keep ONE entry and delete the other plus these _comment keys.
